notes.subject: בער
notes.rationale: Motso o bolela 'ho ja' kapa 'phoofolo' — 'ya tswetseng peo' kapa 'phoofolo e sa ntseng peo'; litlhaku tsa kamehla di bolela 'phoofolo e tswetseng peo'

notes.subject: אהב...אהב
notes.rationale: Phetoho e boeleditsweng (o rata...o rata) — boitšoaro bo boeleloa, se sieo ka Sekhohya

notes.subject: ס
notes.rationale: Sehlopha sa semmušo se sieo; se hlahisitšwe e le 'e tswetseng peo'

translation: Ya ratang kahlolo o rata tsebo; mme ya hloyang teko e mpe oa bua sesotho <sese>.

tokens.gloss: teko e mpe oa bua sesotho
